hf:microsoft/Aion-1.0-Instruct-2.3B-ONNX.description: Microsoft Windows Applied Sciences Group > This repository contains the **ONNX WebGPU** quantized version of **Aion Instruct v1**. > For the full model description, intended uses, limitations, safety information and evaluation results, see the original model card: microsoft/Aion-1.0-Instruct-2.3B.

hf:inclusionAI/Ling-3.1-flash-1019-singp.description: SingProbe is an **intrinsic streaming guardrail** for `Ling-3.1-flash-1019`. Its attention head reads three layers of the base model's hidden states during generation and scores query intent, response unsafety, and hallucination risk at each token.
